meta.1일 1회 1포를 100~200mL의 물, 우유, 두유 등에 혼합하여 섭: Take 1 stick pack mixed in 100–200 mL of water, milk or soy milk, 1 time a day.
meta.1일 2회, 1회 3회씩(0.15ml씩 약 3회 분사) 구강에 분무하여: Spray into the mouth (about 3 sprays of 0.15 mL each) and take, 2 times a day.
meta.1일 3회, 1회 0.6ml(0.15ml씩 약 4회 분사)를 구강에 분무: Spray 0.6 mL (about 4 sprays of 0.15 mL each) into the mouth and take, 3 times a day.
meta.1일 2회, 1회 1포(3.3g)을 물(150~180ml)에 넣고 잘 저: Add 1 stick pack (3.3 g) to water (150–180 mL), stir well and drink, 2 times a day.
meta.보통성인 1일 1회, 1회 1환(3.75g)을 천천히 입안에서 녹여 씹어: An average adult should let 1 pellet (3.75 g) dissolve slowly in the mouth and chew it, 1 time a day.
meta.1일 3회, 1회 동봉된 스푼(1g)을 사용하여 직접 또는 냉, 온수에: Using the enclosed spoon (1 g), take it directly or mixed in cold or warm water, 3 times a day
meta.1일 3회, 1회 3g(1스푼)을 동봉된 스푼을 사용하여 냉수나 온수에: Using the enclosed spoon, take 3 g (1 spoonful) in cold or warm water, 3 times a day.
meta.1일 1회, 1회 한스푼(1g)씩 온수 또는 냉수 80ml에 넣고 저은: Stir one spoonful (1 g) into 80 mL of warm or cold water and take, 1 time a day.
meta.1일 2회, 1회 1포(3 g) 또는 1일 1회, 1회 1포(6g)를 물: Chew and take 1 stick pack (3 g) with water 2 times a day, or 1 stick pack (6 g) 1 time a day.
meta.1일 1포를 취향에 따라 찬물 또는 따뜻한 물 80-100ml(종이컵 2: Take 1 stick pack a day mixed in 80–100 mL of cold or warm water (2/3 of a paper cup) to taste.
meta.1일 3회, 1회 1캡슐을 물과 함께 섭취하십시오. 1일 1회, 1회 3: Take 1 capsule with water, 3 times a day. Or take 3 capsules with water, 1 time a day.
meta.1일 1회, 1회 1포을 충분히 씹어서 섭취하십시오. 냉장보관하여 시원하: Chew 1 stick pack well and take it, 1 time a day. Refrigerating it and taking it chilled improves the texture and taste.
meta.1일 3회, 1회 30g(동봉된 스푼으로 2스푼)을 물 또는 우유, 기타: Mix 30 g (2 spoonfuls with the enclosed spoon) with water, milk or another beverage, shake and take, 3 times a day.
meta.동봉된 스푼을 이용하여 1일 3회, 한스푼(1g상당)씩 직접 드시거나,: Using the enclosed spoon, take one spoonful (about 1 g) directly, or stirred into 80 mL of warm or cold water, 3 times a day.
meta.동봉된 스푼을 이용하여 1일 2회, 한스푼(2g상당)씩 직접 드시거나,: Using the enclosed spoon, take one spoonful (about 2 g) directly, or stirred into 80 mL of warm or cold water, 2 times a day.
meta.① 성인 1일 1회, 1회 1포(10ml)를 섭취하십시오. ② 15세 이: ① Adults should take 1 stick pack (10 mL), 1 time a day. ② Children aged 15 or under should take 1/2 of the adult amount.
meta.1.1일 3회, 1회에 1g(동봉된 스푼)을 냉수나 온수에 타서 잘 저어: 1. Take 1 g (the enclosed spoon) mixed and stirred well in cold or warm water, 3 times a day. 2. Used as a health functional food ingredient.
meta.500mg : 1일 1회, 1회 2캡슐을 물과 함께 섭취하십시오. 100: 500 mg: Take 2 capsules with water, 1 time a day. 1,000 mg: Take 1 capsule with water, 1 time a day.
meta.- 성인 1일 3회, 1회 1g을 한컵(80ml 정도)의 온수나 냉수에: – Adults should take 1 g mixed in a cup (about 80 mL) of warm or cold water, or directly, 3 times a day. – Children aged 15 or under should take about half.
meta.1일 2회, 1회 5.5g씩 식전 충분한 물과 함께 곧바로 섭취하거나 또: Take 5.5 g with plenty of water before meals, immediately, or suspend it in plenty of water and take it immediately, 2 times a day (total daily intake: 11 g)
meta.최종제품 : 1일 3회, 1회 1g 씩 온수 또는 냉수에 타서 드시거나: Final product: Take 1 g mixed in warm or cold water, or directly, 3 times a day. Children aged 15 or under should take about half of the above amount.
meta.1일 1회, 1회 1포(7.2g)를 250~300ml의 물에 타서 섭취하: Take 1 stick pack (7.2 g) mixed in 250–300 mL of water, 1 time a day. (Using a Unicity shaker makes it even easier.)
meta.① 컵에 물을 채워 입에 물 한모금을 머금고, 1포를 투여 후, 물과 함: ① Fill a cup with water, hold a mouthful of water in your mouth, add 1 stick pack and swallow it with the water. Rinse your mouth with the remaining water. ② If it is uncomfortable to take, mix it into a beverage or juice.
meta.① 1일 2회, 1회 1.5g (동봉된 스푼 이용)을 그대로 또는 온수나: ① Take 1.5 g (using the enclosed spoon) as is or mixed in 80–100 mL of warm or cold water, 2 times a day. ② When used as a raw material, use it in accordance with the functional claim, daily intake, specifications and requirements of the final health functional food product.
